chosen_time_anchors.entry: next legal minute open strictly after the trigger bar
chosen_time_anchors.environment_daily_state: completed sessions strictly before attack date
chosen_time_anchors.exit: next legal execution after completed failure information
chosen_time_anchors.feature_rule: no feature may use a bar after its own decision timestamp
chosen_time_anchors.gap_inventory_history: completed QD-004 bars no later than ATTACK_START_TIME for admission-state features
chosen_time_anchors.minute_attack_state: completed minutes no later than each candidate decision timestamp

economic_sequence: historical inventory may or may not exist around [L,U]
post-gap turnover may preserve or replace that inventory
market / board / industry environment repairs or remains weak
the market accepts or rejects price inside the gap
current attack reaches U, causally resets, or times out
position exits under its frozen policy
a later independent attack may create at most one retry signal
entry_time: next legal one-minute open strictly after completed trigger information
possible_ambiguities: historical volume is not identical to currently surviving inventory
low volume under a locked limit state is not absence of supply
high attack volume may indicate demand or supply absorption
a later successful attack must not validate an earlier failed attack
high-overhang U breakout is a different strategy from gap repair
old horizontal trading may be support, resistance, or both
absolute percentage penetration and gap-width penetration differ

research_correction.attack_episode: primary trading unit; later attacks never relabel earlier attacks
research_correction.attack_success: U before the current attack's own causal reset
research_correction.high_overhang: separate absorption-breakout mechanism and excluded from primary returns
research_correction.overhead_inventory: historical turnover/volume proxy, not observed actual selling
research_correction.price_true_gap: establishes no trades only on the gap-formation transition

trigger: causal completed-bar acceptance inside the current attack
